The recovered LevelWinDialog prefab now renders through the actual runtime UiDialog/manager and native star/pillow cues; the visible standard Continue Button reaches the actual GameExit manager, NoGame state, no-loading UI preparation and real DialogManager.ClearDialogs/UiDialog force-close/flow completion once.
